motion.name: ease-premium
motion.purpose: Main easing for transitions and reveals.

components.name: Golden Button
components.description: Primary action button with gradient and inner glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D4A017 0%, #B8860B 100%); color: white; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-gold::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.5s ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.3); }

components.name: Premium Card
components.description: Translucent card with glass-morphism and hover lift.
components.html:
Policy Pillar

Detailed campaign promise goes here.
components.css: .ds-card-premium { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-card-premium:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); } .ds-card-premium h3 { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-premium p { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: white; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Eyebrow Tag
components.description: Small categorized tag for section labeling.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.2); color: #D4A017; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The Visionary Vanguard is a design system built for high-stakes leadership and national representation. It balances the urgency of youth activism with the professional restraint of a serious policy platform. The aesthetic is 'Professional, Calm, and Policy-Focused.'
keyCharacteristics: Strategic Contrast: Gold accents for critical actions.
Modern Heritage: Bold industrial display paired with trusted serif.

rules.name: The Golden Ratio Rule
rules.body: The Golden accent should never cover more than 5% of a screen's surface area. Its power comes from its rarity.

rules.name: The No-Image-Animate Rule
rules.body: Don't animate image transforms on hover; use the container's lift or border instead.

dos: Do use text-wrap: balance on all section headers.
Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all body text.
Do use the doppelrand effect to give containers a premium, finished feel.
donts: Don't use gold for large background areas; it is for guidance, not coverage.
Don't use generic 'SaaS gray' for text; use pure white or high-opacity transparencies.
Don't animate image transforms on hover.
